reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing getScheduledAmount, which forecast, schedules/app, preview and the client already call, and replaces schedule-template's last inline midpoint with a call to it.

duplication.why: Removes the one remaining copy of the range computation (schedule-template's isbetween ternary) and adds none.

placement.why: The rule stays in shared/schedules.ts, the module every server and client consumer already imports it from.

scope.why: A two-line rule change, one call-site cleanup, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: After the change every consumer resolves a schedule's planned amount through one function, so later rule changes are a one-place edit backed by focused tests; the only nit is the release note missing its authors field.

bypasses_abstraction.where: schedule-template.ts, the one site that previously re-implemented the midpoint, now calls getScheduledAmount

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic remains or is introduced

one_place.where: getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts defines the ranged-amount rule and every consumer (forecast, schedules/app updateActions and posting, preview, schedule-template, client components) calls it with the raw amount
